name: Sentrook OpenClaw
description: Sentrook trajectory scanner. Scans tool calls and can allow, require human approval, or block flagged actions.

apiKey.description: Do not set here. Use the Sentrook tab setup form or SENTROOK_SCAN_API_KEY in ~/.openclaw/.env. SecretRefs in plugin JSON can fail-close the gateway.

clientId.description: Do not set here. Use the Sentrook tab setup form or SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_ID in ~/.openclaw/.env (or compose env_file).

clientSecret.description: Do not set here. Use the Sentrook tab setup form or SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_SECRET in ~/.openclaw/.env. SecretRefs in plugin JSON can fail-close the gateway.

oidcIssuer.description: OIDC issuer base URL. Default https://identity.firstdataunion.org. Env: SENTROOK_OIDC_ISSUER.

oidcAudience.description: Expected token audience. Default sentrook. Env: SENTROOK_OIDC_AUDIENCE.

oidcScope.description: OAuth scope requested for scan tokens. Default sentrook.scan. Env: SENTROOK_OIDC_SCOPE.

timeoutMs.description: Wait for POST /scan including OIDC mint (ms). Default 14000 so the hook stays inside OpenClaw 2.0's 15s fail-closed before_tool_call budget. Env: SENTROOK_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS. Values above 10 minutes are capped.

onScanError.description: When /scan times out, cannot connect, returns 5xx, is rate-limited after retry, auth fails (401/403), or a 200 body has invalid JSON / a missing or unknown decision. allow = continue without scanning (auth still blocks). deny = block the tool. review = ask (interactive); unattended always blocks. Default review. Unexpected plugin errors always block. Env: SENTROOK_ON_SCAN_ERROR.

mode.description: Feedback for review resolutions (allow-once / deny). off = disabled. submit = POST sanitized candidates to Sentrook /feedback (forwarded to Rookery). Configure wizard defaults to submit (community corpus contribution); opt out with feedback.mode=off or --contribute-corpus false.

approval.description: Human approval timeouts for interactive review cards. Unattended hosted reviews are blocked (OpenClaw cannot deliver plugin cards on cron; see github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/138853). Values above 600000 ms are capped.

interactiveTimeoutMs.description: Review timeout for interactive sessions (ms). Default 600000 (10 min). Capped at 10 min. Env: SENTROOK_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS.

scheduledTimeoutMs.description: Kept for compatibility. Unattended hosted reviews block immediately instead of waiting. Env: SENTROOK_SCHEDULED_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS.

scheduledTimeoutBehavior.description: Deprecated. Unresolved reviews always deny (OpenClaw 2.0 ignores timeoutBehavior). The key is still accepted so older configs load. Env: SENTROOK_SCHEDULED_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_BEHAVIOR.

scheduledIntentKinds.description: Root intent kinds that use the scheduled (unattended) policy. Default [cron, heartbeat]. Subagents inherit the parent unless subagent is listed here.

sensitivity.description: Attended review floor after a review. strict always prompts. info / warning / critical auto-approve that severity and below (legacy lenient = info). Includes hard L2 reviews. Never skips block or scan-error. Env: SENTROOK_SENSITIVITY.

unattendedSensitivity.description: Cron/subagent review floor after a review. Same tokens as sensitivity. Default strict. Allow-all and quiet do not apply. Env: SENTROOK_UNATTENDED_SENSITIVITY.

operatorLog.description: Local operator JSONL (on by default). Path $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/sentrook-operator.jsonl. Env: SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG, SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG_PATH, SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG_MAX_DAYS, SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG_MAX_BYTES.

enabled.description: When false, scanning still works but history is empty after restart. Env: SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG=0.

path.description: Override operator log path. Env: SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG_PATH.

maxAgeDays.description: Drop lines older than this many days (default 14). 0 disables age purge. Env: SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG_MAX_DAYS.

maxBytes.description: Rotate the live file near this size (default 33554432). Env: SENTROOK_OPERATOR_LOG_MAX_BYTES.

allowlist.description: Local short-circuit for allow-always decisions. Stores skeletons / script content hashes under ~/.openclaw; does not override Sentrook blocks.

enabled.description: When true (default), allow-always records a local entry and matching future reviews skip requireApproval. Env: SENTROOK_ALLOWLIST_ENABLED.

path.description: Override path for sentrook-allowlist.json. Default ~/.openclaw/sentrook-allowlist.json (or $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/...). Env: SENTROOK_ALLOWLIST_PATH.

scriptBind.description: When true (default), interpreter+local-script forms are stored as path+SHA-256 bindings. Env: SENTROOK_ALLOWLIST_SCRIPT_BIND.

apiKey.label: Do not set — use Sentrook setup / .env

clientId.label: Do not set — use Sentrook setup / .env

clientSecret.label: Do not set — use Sentrook setup / .env
